title: Odbrana od prompt injectiona
summary: Odbrana od direktne i indirektne prompt injection kao arhitekturni problem: najmanje sposobnosti, razdvajanje privilegija i obrasci dizajna (dual LLM, plan-then-execute, action-selector), autorizacija poziva alata u kodu, ljudska potvrda, spotlighting, obrada ulaza, klasifikatori i monitoring.
summary_en: Defending against direct and indirect prompt injection as an architectural problem: least capability, privilege separation and design patterns (dual LLM, plan-then-execute, action-selector), tool-call authorization in code, human confirmation, spotlighting, input handling, classifiers and monitoring.
